App.name: Kariakoo Shop Manager

Login.title: Sign in
Login.description: Welcome back. Sign in to your shop.

Register.title: Create your account
Register.description: You can create or join a shop after confirming your email.
Register.sent: If the details are valid, we have sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address, then sign in.

VerifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
VerifyEmail.done: Your email is confirmed. You can now sign in.
VerifyEmail.missing: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again, or request a new one.
VerifyEmail.resent: If that address has an unconfirmed account, we have sent a new link.

ForgotPassword.title: Reset your password
ForgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
ForgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {email}, we have sent a link to reset the password. The link expires in 30 minutes.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.description: This signs you out on every device.
ResetPassword.done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
ResetPassword.missing: This link is incomplete. Request a new reset link.

NewShop.title: Create a shop
NewShop.description: You will be the owner. You can add staff later.

Home.noShops: You are not a member of any shop yet. Create one to get started, or ask a shop owner to add you.
Home.comingSoon: Sales, purchases and credit arrive in the next releases.
Home.bannerGrace: Your subscription has ended. You still have full access for a few days.
Home.bannerRestricted: This shop is read-only because the subscription has ended. Records are kept and can be viewed.
Home.bannerAskOwner: Ask the shop owner to renew.

Team.title: Team
Team.noAccess: You do not have permission to see the team.
Team.inviteHint: They will get an email with a link that works once and expires in 7 days.
Team.memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}
Team.roleNameRequired: Enter a name of up to 60 characters.

AcceptInvitation.title: Join a shop
AcceptInvitation.missing: This page needs the link from your invitation email.
AcceptInvitation.signInFirst: Sign in with {email} to accept. If you do not have an account yet, create one with that address.
AcceptInvitation.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {email}. Sign out and sign in with the invited address.

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.loadFailed: Could not load the subscription. Refresh to try again.
Subscription.noAccess: You do not have permission to view the subscription.

explain.TRIALING: Every feature is included during the trial.
explain.GRACE: Your paid period has ended. Pay before the grace period ends to keep full access.
explain.RESTRICTED: You can view and export records and record customer debt payments. New sales, purchases, stock changes and staff invitations are paused until you pay. Nothing is deleted.

Subscription.payDescription: Pay with mobile money, then enter the transaction reference from your confirmation message.
Subscription.noPlans: No plans are available yet. Contact support to subscribe.
Subscription.noInstructions: Payment instructions have not been set yet. Contact support before paying.
Subscription.referenceInvalid: Enter the reference exactly as it appears in your payment message (letters and numbers).
Subscription.manualNote: Your access changes only after our team confirms the payment. This is not an automatic deduction.
Subscription.waiting: Payment received for checking. Waiting for confirmation; access will update once it is confirmed.

Platform.title: Platform admin
Platform.noAccess: This page is for platform staff only.
Platform.paymentsDescription: Check that the money arrived before confirming. Confirming adds the paid time at once.
Platform.plansDescription: Prices and limits shops can choose. Changing a price applies to payments started afterwards.
Platform.noPlans: No plans yet. Shops cannot pay until you add one.
Platform.name: Name
Platform.planInvalid: Check the plan: code (lowercase letters, digits, - or _), name and a price with at most 2 decimal places are required.
Platform.settingsDescription: A new trial length applies to shops created after the change.
Platform.instructionsPlaceholder: For example: Pay to M-Pesa Lipa Namba ... in the name ...
Platform.settingsInvalid: Trial days must be 0 to 90 and reminder days 0 to 30.

Products.title: Products
Products.noAccess: You do not have permission to view products.
Products.lowStockAlert: {count, plural, one {# product is} other {# products are}} at or below the reorder level.
Products.loadFailed: Could not load products. Try again.
Products.noCreate: You do not have permission to add products.
Products.baseUnitHelp: The smallest unit you count stock in, such as piece or kg. It cannot be changed later.
Products.allowFraction: Allow parts of a unit (up to 3 decimal places, for kg or metres)
Products.openingHelp: How much you have now. You can record this once; later changes are stock adjustments.
Products.conversionFixed: The number of base units cannot be changed after saving.
Products.restoreHelp: This product is archived and hidden from the list.
Products.archiveHelp: Archive products you no longer sell. Stock must be zero first.

Inventory.title: Inventory

Inventory.loadFailed: Could not load stock. Try again.
Inventory.negativeAllowed: Sales may take stock below zero. Those products are flagged.
Inventory.negativeBlocked: Sales cannot take stock below zero.
Inventory.negativeHelp: Stock adjustments never go below zero, whatever this setting.
Inventory.ownerOnly: Only a shop owner can change this.
Inventory.reconcileHelp: Compares every product's stock with its full history of changes.
Inventory.reconcileOk: {count, plural, one {# product checked. It matches its history.} other {All # products match their history.}}
